title: DXB - Benetti 35m
highlights: Sky lounge with bar and 100" projector
New tender and upgraded AV systems
description:
DXB is a tri-deck Benetti motor yacht by Stefano Righini, offering three full decks of exterior living space few yachts in her class can match. A comprehensive 2025 refit has brought her to as-new condition: custom furniture, leather accents, premium linens, a new teak sundeck, a new tender and upgraded entertainment systems.

Zuretti's interior features high-gloss cherry woods and full-height glazing in the main salon, with a formal dining area forward and a sky lounge with bar and a 100-inch projector. She sleeps ten guests in five cabins, including a full-beam main-deck master suite. Price on request.
